answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 20051 Country: India Title: after urination how to clean like can i touch penis with water & clean.(some droplets of urine will be present on mouth of penis) or first wipe drops of urine on penis by tissue then pour water and rub .bcoz if i touch urine i will be punished in grave. plz reply Question: after urination how to clean like can i touch penis with water & clean.(some droplets of urine will be present on mouth of penis) or first wipe drops of urine on penis by tissue then pour water and rub .bcoz if i touch urine i will be punished in grave. plz reply Answer ID: 20051 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 376/376/M=1431) After urination, first clean the drop of private part with tissue paper or clod and then wash it with water, this is the best way. However, istinja can be done with water only. Left hand should be used for istinja . The warning of grave punishment is meant for those not saving themselves from the splash of urine. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
